# Overall Project Summary: July 19, 2026

Development on July 19 focused on stabilizing the core infrastructure, with significant progress in CI/CD hardening and cloud voice session reliability. While the team successfully migrated to TypeScript 7 and implemented atomic voice quotas, ongoing regressions in packaged desktop environments and nightly E2E tests remain the primary blockers for stability.

## 🚨 Needs Attention 
- **[elizaos/eliza#13681](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13681) Nightly App Live E2E**: The scheduled desktop-packaged lane is failing in chat, walkthrough, and renderer mounts, requiring urgent investigation.
- **[elizaos/eliza#13889](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/13889) Packaged Desktop (Linux)**: Full golden-path verification is pending; requires input on first-run runtime choices and pairing screen visibility.

## ✅ Completed Work

**CI/CD and Infrastructure Hardening**
*   Improved build stability by integrating circular-bootstrap blockers into the CI pipeline ([elizaos/eliza#16657](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16657)).
*   Completed the migration to TypeScript 7 to enhance supportability and performance ([elizaos/eliza#16655](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16655)).

**Cloud Voice and Session Management**
*   Ensured reliable usage tracking by implementing atomic realtime voice quotas via Redis EVAL ([elizaos/eliza#16654](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16654)).
*   Enhanced session reliability by fixing revocation polling and forwarding request-scoped Redis stores ([elizaos/eliza#16669](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16669)).
*   Mitigated memory-intensive snapshot hydration through strict byte-budget enforcement ([elizaos/eliza#16647](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16647)).

**Desktop and UI Stability**
*   Resolved unit test failures by repairing drifted service harnesses in the orchestrator ([elizaos/eliza#16642](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16642)).
*   Improved chat UI integrity by isolating parallel conversation turns and ensuring recovery after reloads ([elizaos/eliza#16660](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16660)).

*   **Voice/Cloud:** [elizaos/eliza#16673](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16673), [elizaos/eliza#16672](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16672), [elizaos/eliza#16671](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16671), [elizaos/eliza#16659](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16659), [elizaos/eliza#16652](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16652)
*   **UI/App:** [elizaos/eliza#16679](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16679), [elizaos/eliza#16668](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16668), [elizaos/eliza#16656](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16656)
*   **Registry/Tooling:** [elizaos/eliza#16670](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/16670)

**Active Discussions**
*   **[elizaos/eliza#16155](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16155)**: Ongoing work to isolate chat inference from monolithic worker bootstrap to reduce cold-start latency.

## 🐞 Issue Triage

**New Issues**
*   **Desktop Packaged Regressions:** [elizaos/eliza#16644](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16644) (renderer mounts), [elizaos/eliza#16645](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16645) (native notification boundaries).
*   **Voice and Auth Stability:** [elizaos/eliza#16650](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16650) (PGlite liveness), [elizaos/eliza#16658](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16658) (chat integrity), [elizaos/eliza#16666](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/16666) (cloud pairing token invalidation).
